subject: Catalyst MAP kickoff — template + week-by-week draft
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Eve Zhao <eve@catalyst.ai>, salesops@catalyst.ai
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Catalyst MAP kickoff — template + week-by-week draft

Eve / Catalyst team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I started a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (MAP) in a GDoc and a 6-slide kickoff deck that outline the 30-day evaluation and the decisions required to close. The goal here is to keep the cadence tight: weekly checkpoints, a short tech validation in week 2, and an acceptance demo in week 4.

What I uploaded:
- MAP template (editable): catalyst-map-template-v1.gdoc — sections: success criteria, stakeholders & owners, evaluation tests, data handoff, security/compliance gates, go/no-go criteria.
- Kickoff slides: catalyst-kickstart-slides-v1.pptx — 6 slides: timeline, owners, tech scope, SLOs, risks & mitigations, next steps.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm primary stakeholder and technical owner on your side by EOD Thu (Dec 3)?
2) Any immediate blocking questions on compliance (SOC 2 / data residency) so we can loop SOC/compliance early?
3) Please add high-level success metrics into the GDoc under the "Core metrics" section — sample metrics are tokens/sec for inference, avg latency P50/P95, and cost per 1k requests.

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): align MAP, confirm stakeholders, share test dataset spec
- Week 1: integration & smoke tests (API keys / network allow-list)
- Week 2: performance evaluation + model-config tuning; produce preliminary perf metrics
- Week 3: reliability & regression checks; QA acceptance criteria validation
- Week 4: acceptance demo + procurement sign-off (SOW and PO)

I left a few inline comments in the doc. Jordan, Jasmine, Marissa — tagging you for owners on tech/metrics/CS.

Thanks — I’ll set a 30-min kickoff on Friday if Catalyst confirms owners.

—
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: catalyst-map-template-v1.gdoc (Google Doc), catalyst-kickstart-slides-v1.pptx (PowerPoint)

Kimberly —

Appreciate the fast turn. We're aligned on the approach and the timeline looks good. Primary stakeholders on our side:
- Biz sponsor: Eve Zhao (me)
- Technical owner: Michael Chen <michael.chen@catalyst.ai> (I'll loop him in shortly)

Quick compliance note: Catalyst operates in multiple regions; for this pilot we need to confirm that logs and any persisted KV caches do not leave our US production VPC. Can your compliance team confirm at a high level (SOC 2 and VPC routing) so we can avoid surprises during week 1?

We added an initial set of success metrics in the doc (high-level) but will refine with Jasmine on the latency targets. Also, can you confirm the test dataset size and a preferred ingestion path (S3 presigned vs secure upload)?

I can do the kickoff on Fri at 10am PT — tentative hold placed.

Thanks —
Eve

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 11:14 AM Eve Zhao <eve@catalyst.ai> wrote:
> Kimberly —
> 
> Appreciate the fast turn. We're aligned on the approach and the timeline looks good. Primary stakeholders on our side: ...

Thanks, Eve — that's helpful. A couple notes from the product/metrics side (drafted in the MAP doc as well):

- Core evaluation tests (suggested):
  1) Functional correctness: 50 prompt templates across expected input types (edge cases included)
  2) Performance stability: 3 sustained runs at target QPS (we'll define QPS with Catalyst)
  3) Regression safety: compare top-5 responses vs your current baseline for precision/recall-ish heuristics

- Metrics to capture each run:
  - Avg latency (P50 / P95), tokens/s, error-rate (>= 5xx or timeouts), memory pressure / OOM events
  - Cost estimate per 1k requests (post-quantization profile if we apply 4-bit)

- Owners: I can own test harness and perf runs; Jordan can drive infra/network allow-list; Marissa will coordinate procurement artifacts and SOW items.

I left specific run scripts and a sample prompt set in the doc under /artifacts. Also added a short acceptance checklist under Week 4 (demo acceptance criteria).

Small ask to Catalyst: if you can drop a representative prompt set (10-15 samples) before EOD Thu, that helps us seed the functional correctness tests earlier.

—
Jasmine Liu
TPM, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

3) Compliance: Eve will share high-level SOC 2 / VPC constraints; we'll loop Security if needed.
4) Kimberly: send calendar invite for kickoff Fri 10am PT and attach the slides.

Meeting invite: sent (Fri 10:00–10:30 PT). I attached the kickoff slides (catalyst-kickstart-slides-v1.pptx) to the invite and left the MAP doc open for real-time co-editing: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CatalystMapDraft
